summary: randomizer roll button stuck on 'That's the only match' (disabled) after Clear Filters grew the pool back from 1 to 196
evidence: Browser repro: filter to a 1-recipe pool (meal type + ingredient text), roll (draws the only match, onlyMatch=true stored on DrawnResult), then click Clear Filters (pool -> 196 recipes) — button stayed disabled reading 'That's the only match' because onlyMatch was frozen on the draw result instead of derived from the live pool size. Fixed in services/web/src/routes/household.randomizer.tsx by dropping onlyMatch from DrawnResult and computing onlyMatchBlocked live off pool.pool.length === 1 each render.
